import datetime,hashlib,json,os,pathlib,re,signal,time,urllib.error,urllib.parse,urllib.request
assert os.geteuid()==1000
mem={x.split(':',1)[0]:x.split(':',1)[1] for x in pathlib.Path('/proc/meminfo').read_text().splitlines()}
assert int(mem['MemAvailable'].split()[0])*1024>=2000000000
root=pathlib.Path('.cache/task12-registry-metadata-20261025-a')
assert not os.path.lexists(root);root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
deadline=time.monotonic()+45
def alarm(_s,_f):raise TimeoutError('absolute registry metadata deadline')
signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM,alarm);signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,45)
class NoRedirect(urllib.request.HTTPRedirectHandler):
 def redirect_request(self,*a,**k):raise RuntimeError('redirect refused')
opener=urllib.request.build_opener(NoRedirect)
base='https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/opensearchproject/opensearch/'
accept='application/vnd.oci.image.index.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.list.v2+json,application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json,application/vnd.docker.distribution.manifest.v2+json'
count=0;total=0;token=None;phase='start'
def save(name,raw):
 fd=os.open(root/name,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:f.write(raw);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
def get(url,name=None,auth=False):
 global count,total
 count+=1;assert count<=6 and time.monotonic()<deadline
 headers={'Accept':accept,'Accept-Encoding':'identity','User-Agent':'Warden-Task12-registry-metadata/1'}
 if auth:headers['Authorization']='Bearer '+token
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers=headers)
 try:response=opener.open(req,timeout=min(8,deadline-time.monotonic()))
 except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
  if e.code!=401:raise
  response=e
 with response:
  status=response.code;hdr=dict(response.headers.items());parts=[];size=0
  while True:
   assert time.monotonic()<deadline
   b=response.read(min(65536,2097153-size))
   if not b:break
   size+=len(b);total+=len(b);assert size<=2097152 and total<=8388608;parts.append(b)
  raw=b''.join(parts)
 if name:save(name,raw)
 return status,hdr,raw
def digest(raw):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
def header(h,key):return next((v for k,v in h.items() if k.lower()==key.lower()),None)
try:
 phase='tag'
 status,headers,raw=get(base+'manifests/2.19.1','initial.json')
 if status==401:
  challenge=header(headers,'WWW-Authenticate')
  assert challenge and challenge.startswith('Bearer ')
  fields=dict(re.findall(r'([a-z]+)="([^"]*)"',challenge))
  assert fields=={'realm':'https://auth.docker.io/token','service':'registry.docker.io','scope':'repository:opensearchproject/opensearch:pull'}
  phase='anonymous-token'
  status,_,authraw=get('https://auth.docker.io/token?service=registry.docker.io&scope=repository%3Aopensearchproject%2Fopensearch%3Apull')
  assert status==200
  authdata=json.loads(authraw);token=authdata.get('token') or authdata.get('access_token')
  assert isinstance(token,str) and 0<len(token)<=32768
  phase='authenticated-tag'
  status,headers,raw=get(base+'manifests/2.19.1','tag.json',True)
 assert status==200
 tag_digest=digest(raw);assert header(headers,'Docker-Content-Digest')==tag_digest
 doc=json.loads(raw);assert doc['schemaVersion']==2
 child_digest=tag_digest
 if 'manifests' in doc:
  matches=[x for x in doc['manifests'] if x.get('platform',{}).get('os')=='linux' and x.get('platform',{}).get('architecture')=='amd64']
  assert len(matches)==1
  chosen=matches[0];child_digest=chosen['digest'];assert re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}',child_digest)
  phase='amd64-manifest'
  status,headers,raw=get(base+'manifests/'+child_digest,'amd64-manifest.json',True)
  assert status==200 and len(raw)==chosen['size'] and digest(raw)==child_digest
  doc=json.loads(raw)
 assert doc['schemaVersion']==2
 layers=doc['layers'];assert 0<len(layers)<=64
 assert all(re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}',x['digest']) and type(x['size']) is int and x['size']>0 for x in layers)
 config=doc['config'];assert re.fullmatch(r'sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}',config['digest'])
 phase='config'
 status,_,raw=get(base+'blobs/'+config['digest'],'config.json',True)
 assert status==200 and len(raw)==config['size'] and digest(raw)==config['digest']
 cfg=json.loads(raw);assert cfg['os']=='linux' and cfg['architecture']=='amd64'
 result={'status':'PASS','at':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'image':'opensearchproject/opensearch:2.19.1','platform':'linux/amd64','tag_digest':tag_digest,'manifest_digest':child_digest,'config_digest':config['digest'],'compressed_layer_bytes':sum(x['size'] for x in layers),'layers':layers,'request_count':count,'metadata_bytes':total,'expanded_and_daemon_peak':'UNKNOWN; no layer GET/pull/container occurred'}
 save('result.json',(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n').encode());print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
except BaseException as exc:
 result={'status':'FAILED','phase':phase,'type':type(exc).__name__,'detail':str(exc)[:512],'request_count':count,'metadata_bytes':total,'no_layer_get':True}
 save('failure.json',(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n').encode());print(json.dumps(result));raise
finally:
 token=None;signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,0)
